transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net customer orders, my name is Fiona. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Fiona. I am extremely annoyed about an order for a secondary TV mini-box. I ordered it over two weeks ago for our spare bedroom, paid the delivery fee, and your tracking portal has been stuck on 'Pending Warehouse Dispatch' for fourteen consecutive days!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can investigate the dispatch status of your TV hardware, Isaac. Let's start with security verification. What is your full name and billing address?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Isaac Newton-Smith, 84 Cambridge Road, Ely, CB7 4HX.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And what is the four-digit security PIN on the account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: What was the online hardware order number provided in your purchase confirmation email?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: The order number is ORD-88192-TV.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And was this ordered as an add-on to your existing primary S-Net TV 4K box?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, for the upstairs bedroom television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Bear with me for a moment while I query the logistics fulfillment database in our central warehouse system.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for your patience, Isaac. I have located order ORD-88192-TV in our Corby logistics depot.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why has it been sitting in the depot for two weeks without moving?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: An automated address formatting validation exception halted the consignment generation because your double-barrelled surname exceeded the standard parcel label character length.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: A surname character limit? That is complete bureaucratic nonsense! Your system took my money instantly, but couldn't print a shipping label because my name has a hyphen? My daughter has been waiting two weeks to watch her shows!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Third-party courier booking software requires strict character spacing for automated barcode sorting.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Well, nobody contacted me to fix it! It just sat in limbo while I was left waiting!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously courier label format exceptions require manual intervention from our dispatch team.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you get this box dispatched immediately?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I will take direct ownership of this order. I have manually edited the recipient label field to fit the courier software standards and prioritized immediate fulfillment.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: When will the physical box actually arrive at my house?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have booked an upgraded DPD Priority Next-Day delivery for tomorrow morning, with a guaranteed one-hour delivery window between nine AM and one PM.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Will I have to pay extra for priority next-day delivery?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: No. In fact, I have credited the original nine pounds ninety-nine delivery fee back to your account, plus an additional fifteen pounds goodwill credit for the two-week delay.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That is very fair, thank you Fiona.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: When the DPD courier arrives tomorrow, you will receive an SMS sixty minutes prior with the driver's name and live GPS tracking link.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: DPD tracking is always very reliable in our area.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And setup of the physical mini-box is plug-and-play: connect the HDMI cable and plug in the power lead, and it will pair automatically over your Wi-Fi.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Does it connect to our Hub 5 Wi-Fi automatically using WPS?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes, press the WPS button on the Hub 5 router for three seconds, and the mini-box will connect in thirty seconds.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Very straightforward, even I can manage that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And you can keep using the Samsung Smart TV app as an additional third screen at no extra charge.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And the voice remote that comes in the box will include pre-installed AAA batteries.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That's an unexpected bonus, we can use it on the tablet as well.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: And your twenty-four-pound credit adjustment will appear on your November billing invoice.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Clear credit on the next statement, perfect.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Let me check the hardware order details again. What was that online hardware order number from your confirmation email?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: As I told you at the start, it's ORD-88192-TV.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Right, order ORD-88192-TV is now flagged as 'Dispatched - Awaiting Courier Collection'.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Is there any way my daughter can watch TV in her room tonight while we wait for DPD tomorrow?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Yes! Do you have a Smart TV, Apple TV, or Fire TV stick in that bedroom?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: We have a Samsung Smart TV with the S-Net TV app already installed.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can provision an immediate S-Net Stream multi-room entitlement token to your account right now. You can log into the app on that TV and stream all subscribed channels live.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That would be wonderful! Let me turn on the bedroom television.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open the S-Net TV app and enter your primary account username and password.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Entering details now... Signed in! The TV channel guide just populated with all our entertainment and movie channels!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Can you select a live channel like Sky Cinema to test video playback?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Selected Sky Cinema Premiere... Playing in high definition with clear surround sound! My daughter can watch her movie tonight after all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That confirms multi-room streaming is fully active right now, and the physical mini-box and voice remote will arrive via DPD tomorrow morning.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: That solves our problem completely. Thank you so much Fiona.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm your mobile phone number for DPD delivery tracking alerts, it is 07700 900512, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, that's my mobile.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Just to confirm for the DPD dispatch label, the delivery address is 84 Cambridge Road, correct?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, 84 Cambridge Road.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there anything else with your TV order or account that I can assist you with today, Isaac?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Fiona, you sorted the dispatch and got our TV working today. Excellent service.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for choosing S-Net, Isaac, and have a wonderful evening.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you Fiona, goodbye.
